data.name: Benchmark_Intro
data.value: Measures each stage of a render on this computer: decoding on the GPU and on the CPU, drawing the overlay with and without shadows, handing frames to ffmpeg, encoding, ffmpeg as a whole and a short real render. Every measurement is repeated, taking turns with the one it's compared to, and the result is the median along with the range of the runs. Then it points out the slowest stage and suggests which settings will be faster here. It takes 2-3 minutes - close games and other programs that use the CPU or GPU heavily meanwhile.

data.name: Cut_MarkOnlyWhatGetsRemoved
data.value: Mark only what gets removed - everything else is rendered. Select a part with I and O, cut it out with X, repeat for every part. Times can also be typed as 1:30 or 1:30.250; click a cut's number to jump to it. A cut between two kept parts can fade through black or white (the render keeps its length) or blend the two parts over each other - then the render is shorter by the length of each such transition, and the preview shows the end of the earlier part there instead of the blend. Only the picture and the sound change, the overlay stays. Cut parts are left out of the video and of the telemetry: the route intro starts with the first kept frame, and distance, elapsed time and the route stats count only what stays in. Playback in the preview skips them.

data.name: EsriKeyGuide_Expiry
data.value: The key works for a year at most - then generate a new one in the same place.

data.name: EsriKeyGuide_Steps
data.value: 1. Create a free account at location.arcgis.com and sign in. 2. On the dashboard, click Create developer credentials. 3. Pick API key credentials and click Next. 4. Where will you use these credentials: Public application - Next. 5. Item access: No item access - Next. 6. Privileges: turn on Basemaps only (2/2) - nothing else - Next. 7. Settings: the latest expiration date (a year from today), leave the referrer URLs empty - Next. 8. Give it a name, e.g. OsmoOverlay - Next. 9. Keep generating the key selected, click Next and copy the key right away - it's shown only once. Paste it here.
